clauses.heading: Parties
clauses.body: This Agreement is made between Summit IT Services LLC and Acme Analytics Inc.

clauses.heading: Term
clauses.body: The term is set out in clause 2.1 to clause 2.3 below.

clauses.heading: Commencement
clauses.body: The term commences one (1) month after 1 November 2025, the date this Agreement is signed.

clauses.heading: Duration
clauses.body: The term is two (2) years from the commencement date.

clauses.heading: Renewal
clauses.body: This Agreement does not renew automatically.

clauses.heading: Payment
clauses.body: Charges are payable quarterly in advance on the first day of each quarter.

clauses.heading: Price Changes
clauses.body: Charges increase by 2 percent on each anniversary of the commencement date.

clauses.heading: Limitation of Liability
clauses.body: The liability of either party is capped at the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim.

clauses.heading: Termination
clauses.body: Either party may terminate for material breach on thirty (30) days written notice.

clauses.heading: Confidentiality
clauses.body: Each party keeps the other party's information confidential.

clauses.heading: Notice of Non-Renewal
clauses.body: Either party may end this Agreement at expiry by giving not less than thirty days written notice before the end of the term.

clauses.heading: Governing Law
clauses.body: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.

clauses.heading: Amendment
clauses.body: By this amendment the term in clause 2.2 is extended to three (3) years from the commencement date.
